assignments.reason: This node represents the faith of the believers in the tzaddik's words, which is the eitza-driver (causal mechanism) that reveals the miracles already present in the tzaddik. By essential nature it belongs to Package 2 (Faith in the Tzaddik and Miracles): the package's bechina core is צדיק = מלא מופתים (the tzaddik's nature IS miraculous fullness), and אמונה בדברי הצדיק is the faith-relationship directed at this same tzaddik. The faith is oriented entirely toward the tzaddik and his words — it is fundamentally a concept within the tzaddik-and-miracles domain, not within the prophecy-and-remez domain of Package 1. The teaching frames אמונה as the key that unlocks the pre-existing miracles in the tzaddik, placing it squarely in the same thematic family.

מופתים (revealed miracles) is the eitza-destination of the faith relationship (edge 1720: אמונה → נתגלין מופתים). By essential nature, miracles belong to Package 2: the package's bechina core establishes that the tzaddik IS full of miracles (מלא מופתים), and מופתים is the revealed, manifest form of that same miraculous fullness. The distinction between מלא מופתים (the intrinsic state) and מופתים (the revealed result) is one of mode (hidden vs. manifest), not of essential nature — both are expressions of the same miraculous reality rooted in the tzaddik. The teaching's opening statement connects miracles directly to the tzaddikim of Kiev, anchoring מופתים firmly in the tzaddik-miracles domain.
